PHOENIX_DBFILE.description: File where phoenix stores the states of the broken nodes

PHOENIX_LOGDIR.description: Directory where logfiles are created in case of problems

PHOENIX_SOFT_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for a soft rebooted node to be considered hard rebootable

PHOENIX_HARD_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout (s) for a hard rebooted node to be considered really broken

PHOENIX_MAX_REBOOTS.description: Max number of simultaneous reboots (soft OR hard)
